plainMeaning: For Bella, Kind asks whether this physical media file represents audio or video. It is distinct from the master clip’s editorial classification or its mix of tracks.
Media Composer has native audio and video descriptor families. Their GetTrackType methods return audio2 and video1; the generic base returns0, so unknown is not automatically video.
The physical file’s exact MDB mob owns its media descriptor. Use that descriptor’s recognized family, not a similarly named unrelated object or the master’s name/usage.
Known class IDs, structural property names and numeric track types are not human text requiring UTF8-versus-MacRoman decoding.
No full media header, audio summary or codec-name parsing is required merely to recognize a supported audio/video descriptor family.

mdvx.purpose: Read-only MDVx ordinary PMR/MDB audio/picture evidence and misleading visible Kind classification audit for Bella. No app launch, media writes, repository edits or Bin Filter changes.
mdvx.method: Fresh universal hash and arm64 symbols; bounded manual static trace of full ordinary scanner, MDB enrichment, metadata helper, row model, filter and table branches; direct arm64 pointer-table decoding. No original source or live displayed-output claim.
mdvx.mainFinding: MDVx has no independent inventory row Kind enum for audio versus video. Its visible KindCellID displays master usage classification (PRECOMP/IMPORTED/etc), while audio recognition uses a private _AUD sentinel in CompressionFourCC and the Compression text Audio. Do not equate MDVx Kind with Bella audio/video Kind.

actualDatabases.purpose: Independent read-only physical-file Kind audit of six live MDBs and paired PMRs; no filename, codec-label, Source Path, OldScanner or master-level Audio/Video label inference.
method: Current source and raw cache hashes are checked before interpretation. Full PMR FileMobId and MasterMobId find unique catalogue-qualified owners.
The physical file owner MOBJ:PhysicalMedia reference selects its descriptor. ObjID must be typed ObjectTag of exactly four bytes.

Actual descriptor classes and property type/width presence are recorded. Audio/Video class semantics are established by the separately traced native MC registration and class ancestry: PCMA/AIFD/WAVD audio; CDCI/RGBA/MPGI video. AIFD/WAVD translate to native AIFC/WAVE before construction.

Own-file and selected-master structural component graphs are inspected without following SourceID into another mob. Only own SCLP TrackKind values and selected-master SCLPs targeting the exact physical FileMobId enter cross-checks.
Reference array and MobIndex declared counts must exactly equal parsed entries. Unsupported widths, missing targets, conflicting kinds and missing physical descriptors are counted explicitly.
MDES:MobKind is recorded separately; source/file role is not Audio/Video Kind.
No media headers or essence are opened. No source-file paths or filenames are used to classify Kind.
limits: All six actual MDBs use the established littleendian legacy Bento/OMF layout. No OMF2 DataKind/DDEF occurrence or unknown descriptor case is established by this corpus.
Missing/corrupt/unsupported Kind inputs may be unexercised; zero observations do not prove those cases impossible.
Dynamic CLSD records extend built-in classes and do not enumerate every built-in descriptor. No missing CLSD entry is called corruption.
Known component wrapper routes are bounded; this is not a universal traversal of arbitrary Avid effect/precompute graphs.
No Bella fallback priority, cross-source precedence or extra header-read trigger is approved by this probe.

supersededBellaProposal.status: Superseded historical proposal: broader-family classification and blank unavailable display were replaced by the exact six-tag lookup and lowercase unknown display approved 19 October 2026.
supersededBellaProposal.owner: Exact full-normalized-FileMobId, catalogue-qualified physical-file owner, then its own safely resolved MOBJ:PhysicalMedia descriptor.
supersededBellaProposal.classification: Known supported native-proven audio/picture descriptor families and explicit legacy wire aliases. Unknown is not video by exclusion.
supersededBellaProposal.retention: Compact Audio/Video/Unknown enum and common compact availability information. App supplies display labels, no text decoding fallback for Kind.
supersededBellaProposal.missingUnsupportedAmbiguousConflicting: Leave MDB-derived Kind unavailable. Do not guess by filename, extension, codec text, master usage, unrelated owners or object order.
supersededBellaProposal.numericMetadataIndependent: A separately unavailable rate/depth/size does not erase a safely established known descriptor family.
supersededBellaProposal.pictureCategory: Supported picture families, including still-picture descriptors, use existing Video category; no new Still result category proposed.
supersededBellaProposal.trackGraph: Research cross-checks only. The revised one-authority MDB proposal uses only the exact physical-file descriptor: do not query, combine, use TrackKind as fallback, or let it veto descriptor-derived Kind merely for this field.
supersededBellaProposal.notApplicable: Unknown Kind does not establish that other technical fields are inapplicable.
supersededBellaProposal.separateType: Master usage/media/precompute classification stays separate from physical-file Kind; MDVx visible Kind is that different usage concept.
supersededBellaProposal.deferred: MDB layout/general structural damage coverage, arbitrary unknown-subclass support, media-header capability/source priority and conditions for extra reads.
supersededBellaProposal.dataFamilyDecision: Native Media Composer DataEssenceDescriptor returns16 and native IsMediaTrackType accepts1/2/16. No Data descriptors observed in six actual MDBs; exact MDB wire mapping and a visible Data result remain undecided. Do not classify unsupported descriptors as Video.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by user on 19 October 2026; requirements only, no runtime implementation.
agreedBellaRule.owner: Exact full-normalized-FileMobId, catalogue-qualified physical-file owner, then its own safely resolved MOBJ:PhysicalMedia descriptor class.
agreedBellaRule.scope: Exactly these six raw descriptor tags for release one. Wider native-known families, aliases, subclasses and Data marks are not silently added.
agreedBellaRule.singleAuthority: Use only the physical-file descriptor class. No TrackKind/master-track queries, cross-checks, fallback, voting or veto solely for Kind. No extension, filename or compression-label guesses.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Small strongly typed Audio/Video/Unknown enum; UI supplies display labels. No duplicate per-row label string, raw descriptor, dynamic mapping or retained graph solely for Kind.
agreedBellaRule.futureCpp17Shape: Small fixed constexpr lookup or equivalent pure function after the requirements review; this approval does not begin runtime implementation.
agreedBellaRule.structuredValue: Exact typed four-byte class tag from supported owner/reference/schema; not a raw text search and no UTF-8/MacRoman fallback.
agreedBellaRule.unusableRead: When no usable class can safely be obtained, return Unknown and keep the physical file. General MDB structural damage treatment remains deferred to the layout review.
agreedBellaRule.independentNumericMetadata: Missing sample rate, bit depth or another independent numeric property does not change a known class lookup result.
agreedBellaRule.otherNativeTypes: No separate Data, Still, Timecode or other display result is added; missing/unmapped descriptor classes display unknown.
agreedBellaRule.notApplicable: Unknown Kind does not prove other technical fields inapplicable.
agreedBellaRule.deferred: MDB layouts/general structural-damage coverage, media-header capabilities, cross-source priority and whether missing MDB Kind justifies another read.

researchPolicySeparation: Embedded native/MDVx recommendations and supersededBellaProposal are historical research, not current Bella rules. agreedBellaRule is authoritative for this field.
